desc: The Pulsar Krypton 2 with a lightweight design and compact size gives you a comfortable viewing experience. It can be used as a handheld or mounted with a Weaver base using a PSP-V Adapter. Features are fast aperture F35/1.0 germanium lens, detection range up to 1400+ yds., high-contrast HD AMOLED display, three levels of sensitivity amplification, video recording, WiFi, Stream Vision 2 app compatibility and 8 color palettes. Includes battery pack and Pulsar Bluetooth remote.
